ValidationRule.description: if Service Center Result is Release Letter Received then Evaluation Result must be Accept Release Letter
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(cc_Service_Centre_Result__c, "Release Letter Received"), ISPICKVAL(cc_Approved_Transfer_Type__c, "Buy Out"), ISCHANGED(cc_Credit_Evaluation_Result__c), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(cc_Credit_Evaluation_Result__c))), NOT(ISPICKVAL(cc_Credit_Evaluation_Result__c, "Accept Release Letter")), ($User.LastName <> "Integration"), ISPICKVAL( Type , "Credit Card Application"), ISPICKVAL(Sub_Type__c, "New Credit Card") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: If Service Center Result is Release Letter Received then Evaluation Result must be Accept Release Letter.
